translation_notes: context shim infixowl_context.py: the region is one method of a vendored copy of rdflib.extras.infixowl; Class, Restriction (needed by super(Restriction, self)), classOrIdentifier and propertyOrIdentifier are re-exported from the installed rdflib.extras.infixowl (identical names/signatures); imported identically by both sides

prefix owl: declared instead of the mechanical owl-ns:: a hyphenated prefix is usable inside islands only, and here owl: terms appear OUTSIDE islands (the not-in membership test and the restrTypes table)
OWL_NS = Namespace(...) dropped on the ldpy side: @prefix absorbs all eight of its uses
the six-entry restrTypes table reads much better as prefixed names in a plain Python list: (allValuesFrom, owl:allValuesFrom), ... - notation gain outside any island
the three graph.add(...) become graph += g{ ... }; one of them has a run-time predicate, written {restrictionType} in predicate position
graph.remove((s, rdf:type, owl:Class)) stays a Python call: there is no removal/filtering island, only the terms benefit from the notation
the two not-in guards stay Python tuple membership tests for the same reason

driver: Probe is a Restriction subclass with an inert constructor so the lifted __init__ can be called on a real Restriction instance; six fixtures cover someValuesFrom, a Class range, a cardinality Literal, the read-back-from-graph else branch, the fully-populated no-op path and the path where the trailing remove actually deletes rdf:type owl:Class
fixtures always pass graph explicitly: the region default graph=Graph() is a shared mutable default, which would otherwise accumulate differently on the two sides
